# WO-521: Privacy proof: a setup file error never repeats what the person typed

## Goal
`setup_config.load` turns a validation error into "path: message" lines and passes `include_input=False` so values are not echoed (`setup_config.py:156-161`), and `to_draft` prefixes wizard errors with the step name (`setup_config.py:201-203`). A setup file holds a name, addresses and consent text, and its errors appear in terminals and bug reports. Tests only: write setup files whose every field has a wrong type, a wrong length or a bad value carrying a sentinel, and assert that no error line, in `load` or `to_draft`, contains the sentinel. A leak is a finding with file:line and a strict xfail.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. For each of: wrong type in name, address, phones, emails, relatives, nicknames, previous names, mailbox host and address, `authorization_file`, a 300-character name, an invalid state, a future birth year and an unknown key (`extra="forbid"`): `SetupFileError.problems` has no sentinel.
2. The error for the "never put the password in the file" case (`setup_config.py:101-108`) does not echo the password value.
3. `to_draft` problems for an invalid email, phone or ZIP name the step and the field only.
4. YAML syntax errors report only the file name (`setup_config.py:150-151`), not the line content (sentinel on the broken line).
5. `SetupFileError.__str__` (joined problems) also has no sentinel.
6. A password read through `read_password` is never in any error text (`password_file` with a sentinel secret and an empty first line, `password_env` set to a sentinel and unset).
7. Files are written under `tmp_path`; sockets blocked; no env leaks (use `monkeypatch.setenv`).

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.

No contract changes: `models.py`, `interfaces.py`, `state.py`, `registry.py`, `storage/`, `schema/`, `cli.py`, `config.py`, `paths.py`, `netpolicy.py`, `consent.py`, `crypto.py`, `secrets.py`, `secret_backends.py`, `logging_setup.py`, `engine/browser.py`. - Every existing test keeps passing unchanged. If your change correctly breaks an in-house or Codex test, stop and report it with file:line; never edit a test outside your allowed paths.
- Typed Python 3.11+, ruff-clean, small focused diff. Logs and events stay PII-free (counts and codes only). Fake people only. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
